contexts.text: The gentiles... are easily imbued with faith.
The states of innocence... with which he becomes imbued from infancy.
That his Intellectual could no longer imbue such a persuasion... Signified.
There are many who... from simplicity... have imbued falsities...
They are (then) imbued with the truths of faith.
The goods and truths with the Lord were (then) imbued with hereditary things from the mother...
From the imbuement of such things from infancy...
For they are unwilling to imbue the Knowledges of truth...
Because (infants) are imbued with no principles of falsity.
As they are imbued with Knowledges...
Thus man, while he is an infant, is imbued with such things.
They who are within the Church can form principles of falsity contrary to the truths of faith, and be imbued with them.
That they shall be imbued and endowed with the goods of faith... Signified.
Whatever they have imbued by means of languages...
By habit the man so imbues it, that...
In proportion as they are... imbued in the life...
But still they are not acknowledged, believed, and imbued, unless the life is according to them.
The man is... afterwards led to imbue (goods and truths); and when the man has been imbued with them, the former things are given to oblivion.
That he imbued the good signified by Laban. Signified.
To tarry... here, = to imbue.
Thus who have imbued it in faith and life.
Unless he has lived in the good of charity, and has thus imbued its affections.
No one can ever receive the truths of faith; namely, imbue and appropriate them to himself, except him who is in the life of charity.
Thus they can never imbue them and appropriate them to themselves; but the things they imbue... are negatives of truth.
From charity they are in the potency to receive and imbue all truths.
Let him consider... whether a man can imbue anything, except what he acts from will.
Wherewith they imbued their internal man. AC 5032:3.
In proportion as he has imbued from the Rational, he is rational...
In proportion as he imbues goods by means of truths...
If evil Spirits do any evil... above what they have imbued from their life (here)...
In their own Hell the one chastises the other according to the evil which they have actually imbued in the world...
Because he has been imbued with truths, and has them in himself.
Some of them have imbued these things, and made them of their faith.
By which they are in a state... to be imbued with intelligence and wisdom...
Then he is led by the Lord to apperceive and imbue those things which are suitable to himself...
So far he can be imbued with wisdom, faith, and love.
The Gentiles are imbued with them.
Because in the life of the body they had not imbued such things as are becoming...
In the state in which he was, he could be imbued with all things of faith, and receive them with interior affection.
They had been imbued with the goods of faith, and still they fell away.
They who from simple good have been in some truth, are imbued with Knowledges; and, through these, with intelligence.
In place of (truths) they are imbued with all the falsity which agrees with the evil of their life.
The memory of Spirits is in their life; for they receive and imbue all things which agree with their life; and they do not receive, still less imbue, the things which do not agree.
He turns himself to infernal Spirits, and is thus imbued as to his spirit with the like wickedness.

All the changes and variations of state in organic substances are such that once imbued they remain permanent. Thus are the lungs imbued to produce various sounds... and when these organics have once been imbued, they are in them, and can be reproduced.
Redeemer. 8. 2. Jehovah God assumed the human... and successively imbued the Divine wisdom and the Divine love.
